title: ALKEMY
tagline: Create a way to recover access to wallets via a secure , decentralized, and anonymous way in the Ethereum ecosystem.
description:
The team at Alkemy decided to explore the use of a defi protocol to help come up with a solution for a non-defi, real world problem. The problem - losing access to your money forever because you forgot the password and lost the seed phrase. 
Our solution - These members, known as "Guardians" will store the piece of information until the "Owner" of the seed phrase requests to recover their seed phrase.
